mapper.sql: select d.division_id as code, d.parent_id as parent_code, case when d.name_local is not null and d.name_local != '' then d.name_local else d.name_en end as name, d.division_level as level, case when exists ( select 1 from base_administrative_division child where child.country_code = d.country_code and child.parent_id = d.division_id ) then false else true end as leaf from base_administrative_division d
